summary.text: David Provencher is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A self-employed Derry resident who serves on the Derry Public Library Board of Trustees, he lists education funding, affordability and the environment as campaign priorities.

paragraphs.text: David Provencher earned a high school diploma from Pinkerton Academy and a bachelor's degree from Daniel Webster College in 2008.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as self-employed.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Provencher said he has been a Derry resident for almost all of his 40 years and currently serves on the Derry Public Library Board of Trustees.

He listed three key campaign messages: increasing state funding to public schools and ending the use of public money for private schools; making the state more affordable by raising the minimum wage and lowering the cost of housing; and investing in renewable energy, rejecting new fossil fuel infrastructure and keeping oversized data centers out of the state.
Provencher advanced from the Democratic primary for Rockingham 13 on September 8, 2026.
